result.message: Search results do not match notion.so. The website notion.so is owned by Notion, and the results show Linear as an integration listed on Notion’s site rather than the owner of the site.

facts.claim: Linear positions itself for software teams and product development, focused on issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.excerpt: Linear empowers software teams to build better products. It streamlines issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Linear has a Notion link preview integration that lets users see real-time previews of Linear content inside Notion.
facts.excerpt: With this link preview integration, you can bring the magic of Linear to Notion. When you paste links from Linear, you’ll be able to see real-time previews of your issues, views, and projects directly in Notion.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Linear’s Notion integration supports issue, project, and view previews with specific fields shown in Notion.
facts.excerpt: For issues, the preview shows issue title, description, status, issue ID, team, assignee, and the date of the last update. Project previews contain project name, associated teams, status, and the project lead. View previews include name and description.

facts.claim: Linear’s Notion connection keeps previews updated when Linear data changes.
facts.excerpt: Once any of these properties change in Linear, the preview in Notion changes accordingly (on page reload or manual preview refresh).

facts.claim: Linear is available as a Notion AI Connector for all Linear organizations.
The Notion AI Connector lets users search Linear projects, issues, and comments from within Notion.
facts.excerpt: Search Linear projects, issues, and comments from Notion.

facts.claim: The connector requires a Notion workspace owner on a Business or Enterprise plan and a Linear Admin.
facts.excerpt: Must be a Notion workspace owner on a Business or Enterprise plan and a Linear Admin to connect.

research.website_note: The website notion.so is owned by Notion, and the results show Linear as an integration listed on Notion’s site rather than the owner of the site.
